title: Reception of the RRCReject by the UE

entities.name: RRCReject
entities.description: RRC message sent by the network to reject connection establishment or resumption requests from the UE.

entities.name: Timer T300
entities.description: Timer used during RRC connection establishment procedure.

entities.name: Timer T319
entities.description: Timer used during RRC connection procedures.

entities.name: Timer T319a
entities.description: Timer used during RRC connection procedures.

entities.name: Timer T302
entities.description: Timer started with waitTime value when RRCReject contains waitTime, during which access barring is applied.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE maintains some connection context but is not actively communicating.

entities.name: waitTime
entities.description: Time value provided in RRCReject message indicating how long access barring should be applied.

entities.name: RRCSetupRequest
entities.description: RRC message sent by UE to request establishment of RRC connection.

entities.name: RRCResumeRequest
entities.description: RRC message sent by UE to request resumption of RRC connection from RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: RRCResumeRequest1
entities.description: Alternative RRC message for connection resumption request.

entities.name: pendingRNA-Update
entities.description: Variable set to true when RNA update is pending after RRCReject reception.

entities.name: SDT Radio Bearers
entities.description: Radio bearers configured for Small Data Transmission.

relations.description: Reception of RRCReject stops timer T300 if running.
Reception of RRCReject stops timer T319 if running.
Reception of RRCReject stops timer T319a if running.
Reception of RRCReject stops timer T302 if running.
Reception of RRCReject starts timer T302 with waitTime value if waitTime is configured.
UE in RRC_INACTIVE state continues to monitor paging while T302 is running.
Reception of RRCReject in response to RNA update or SDT resume sets pendingRNA-Update to true.
Reception of RRCReject causes suspension of SRB1 and radio bearers configured for SDT.
RRCReject received in response to RRCSetupRequest triggers connection setup failure indication to upper layers.
RRCReject received in response to RRCResumeRequest triggers connection resume failure procedures.
RRCReject received in response to RRCResumeRequest1 triggers connection resume failure procedures.
